================================================================================
  EXCLUSIVE DOWNLOAD MANAGER (EDM) v1.0 — SECURITY & ANTI-TAMPER NOTICE
================================================================================

1. ANTI-TAMPER & INTEGRITY PROTECTION:
   - Every executable binary and setup file produced for EDM v1.0 is cryptographically
     hashed with SHA-256 and SHA-512 algorithms.
   - To ensure your setup file is genuine and has not been modified by malicious
     third parties, run `Verify_Integrity.bat`.
   - If the SHA-256 checksum does not match, DO NOT execute the installer.

2. LOCAL-FIRST ZERO TRACKING GUARANTEE:
   - EDM adheres to a strict "Local-First" privacy policy.
   - No telemetry, search terms, download URLs, or file contents are ever uploaded to cloud servers.
   - All speed calculations and graph visualizations occur 100% locally in your system memory.

3. MEMORY & PROCESS SECURITY:
   - High-Entropy Virtual Addressing (64-bit ASLR enabled).
   - Data Execution Prevention (DEP / NX enabled).
   - Temporary chunk files are securely isolated on local disk and verified with MD5/SHA-256.

4. OFFICIAL CHECKSUMS (SHA-256):
   - EDM_Setup_v1.0.exe:
     1865BE4F63E42E6FA9485B6883E46F44951DE895335795ABE7EDB9614BDCE467
   - edm-chrome-extension-v1.0.0.zip:
     1A38520801610D071DEB41C62A35A45E187FF8ADEF815761321B4A136E7DD48D
   - edm-edge-extension-v1.0.0.zip:

   - edm-firefox-extension-v1.0.0.zip:
